metadata.title: Bounded Spaces without a Geodesic in the Gromov-Hausdorff Class
metadata.abstract: We construct two countable complete bounded metric spaces at Gromov-Hausdorff distance $1/4$ with no midpoint and hence no shortest curve between them. The proof uses the local existence of optimal correspondences near a space with finitely many self-correspondences of distortion below a fixed positive threshold, each of which is the graph of a bijection.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 构造两个可数、完备、有界度量空间，其Gromov–Hausdorff距离为1/4，却不存在中点，从而两者之间没有最短曲线。论证使用在某类低畸变自对应有限且均为双射图的空间附近，最优对应的局部存在性。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出完备有界但非紧空间在GH类别中缺乏最短路径的显式例子。
analysis.limitations: 例子为可数完备有界空间，不属于一般紧空间GH几何；局部最优对应结论有特殊自对应假设。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
